notes: Stems regroup the checkpoint-26 arrangements: lead + padbass + percussion sum to the shipped checkpoint-26 master within 24-bit quantisation (max abs diff <= 5e-7, about 2 LSB); re-checked from real bytes by check_composed_score_md3_v1.py

Intros/outros are 2-bar one-shots at the parent cue's tempo (-22 LUFS target, same as the music); an intro ends on a handoff bell at the loop's first downbeat, an outro closes on the tonic pad + bell with a 0.5 s fade. The full flute tail stays reserved for the resolve stinger and rift_finale: only the rift_finale outro plays it (the set's only full close); the thang_long outro uses the low pluck tail, the thang_long precedent (the cue itself answers with the tail in low pluck at bars 10-11); the boss outro uses the minor-head pluck fragment and the sa_hoa outro its A-minor mapped head.

Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the MD3 files are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, their cue bindings, or the checkpoint-26/30/MD1/MD2 cues.

No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes. Loop seams are recorded per looping cue in the delivery manifest: wrapJump after a disclosed 0.25 s end-landing loop construction, wrapJumpRaw before it.
